name: Halcyon Coffee
description: A corner café with mismatched chairs. Rain on the window most of the year. Closes at 7:15 and never on time.

name: Corvel Palace
description: Gold stairs, orange trees, and a guest list nobody admits to reading. The family use the east door; everyone else is photographed.

name: The flat on Ardenne
description: Two students, one sofa, a television nobody watches. Paint drying on the radiator.
